content.short: NFT Price Floor provides a dashboard to track NFT market data.
content.description: NFT Price Floor provides a dashboard that addresses NFT market data needs in a creator economy currently dominated by centralized Web2 networks that extract value and can censor users. Web3 enables NFTs to serve as monetization tools that help the creator economy grow more freely. As NFTs become part of daily life, this dashboard is built to give the community a clear, accessible view of NFT markets and trends, helping users stay informed about developments and market dynamics in a single, convenient interface.
